text: Term: Abrus precatorius Linn.. Ayurveda name: guj. Unani name: Aninud deek/Ghonghchi/Achnata Phal. Siddha name: Kundrimani, Kundri. Common name: crab's eye, jequerity, pois rouge, precatory bean, rosary pea, rosarypea, tento muido, Indian liquorice.
Term: Acacia arabica/nillotica Willd.. Ayurveda name: babbla. Unani name: Aqaaqia/Mughilaan/Kikar/Babool/Qaraz. Siddha name: Karuvel. Common name: Babul, Black Babul, Indian Gum arabic tree.
Term: Acacia catechu. Ayurveda name: khadira. Unani name: Khair/Kath Safaid. Siddha name: Karungali, Kashukatti, Vodalai, Vodalam. Common name: cutch tree.
Term: Aconitum chasmanthum Stapf & Holmes / Aconitum ferox Wall. ex Ser.. Ayurveda name: gika via. Common name: Indian aconite.
Term: Aconitum ferox Wall. ex Ser.. Ayurveda name: vatsanbha bheda. Unani name: Khaaniq-al-Zeb. Siddha name: Vasha naabi,Vidam,Pachai naabi, Vishnanuir. Common name: Indian aconite.
Term: Aconitum heterophyllum Wall. ex Royle. Ayurveda name: ativi. Unani name: Atees/Patees. Siddha name: Ahividayam,Pangurai,Madiri. Common name: indian atees.
Term: Acorus calamus Linn.. Ayurveda name: vac. Unani name: Waj-e-Turki. Siddha name: Vasambu, Suduvaan, Uraippaan, Paersollaamarundhu, Pillaimarundhu, Vasamber. Common name: calamus, sweetflag.

Term: Aegle marmelos Correa ex Roxb.. Ayurveda name: bilva. Unani name: Bil/ Bel / Belgiri / Bael / Safarjal Hindi / Shull / Ball / Tull /Nall. Siddha name: Vilvam ,koovilum,sivathurumum, Maaloram, Vilvo. Common name: Indian bael.
Term: Alangium salviifolium. Ayurveda name: akoa. Unani name: Aankola/Dhira/Anbaku. Siddha name: Azhinjil,Semmaram,Sei.

Term: Alhagi maurorum Baker Dexv / Alhagi pseudalhagi. Ayurveda name: yavsaka, dhanvaysa. Unani name: Haaj / Turanjabeen/Jawaasa/Jawaansa. Siddha name: Thurunjibin, Tulganari. Common name: camel thorn, persian manna plant.
Term: Allium sativum. Ayurveda name: launa, lahasuna. Unani name: Seer. Siddha name: Poondu, Lasunam, Ulli, Vellaippoondu, Vellulli. Common name: Garlic, cultivated garlic.
Term: Alocasia macrorrhiza. Ayurveda name: mnaka. Siddha name: Merugankilangu, Ulakkai, Kandhaputpi, Musalam. Common name: Giant taro.

Term: Aloe barbadensis Mill.. Ayurveda name: kumr. Unani name: Gheekawaar/Sibr. Siddha name: Katrazhai,Kumari, Chirukatrazhai, Rattabolam, Kariyabolam. Common name: Barbedos aloe, Indian aloe, Curacao aloe, Jaffarabad aloe.
Term: Alstonia scholaris. Ayurveda name: saptapara. Unani name: Kashim/Chatim. Siddha name: Ezhilai palai, Mukkampalai, Sapthaparni, Pala. Common name: Dita bark.
Term: Amomum subulatum Roxb.. Ayurveda name: sthlael bheda. Unani name: Heel Kalaan/Qaaqulah Kabeer. Siddha name: Periya elakkai, Kaattu elam, Aruga sani. Common name: Greater or Nepal Cardamom.
Term: Amorphophallus campanulatus. Ayurveda name: sraa. Unani name: Zamin Kand Beghi/Soran. Siddha name: Kaaraa karunai, Karanaikilangu, Sooram. Common name: Elephant-foot Yam.
Term: Anacyclus pyrethrum DC.. Ayurveda name: krakarabha. Unani name: Aaqarqarha /Oodul-Qarah. Siddha name: Akrakaaram, Akkirakaaram. Common name: Pellitory of Spain, Pyrethrum.
Term: Andrographis paniculata. Ayurveda name: bhnimba, klamegha. Siddha name: Nila vembu,Kriyaathu,Anaariathitham,Shiratkuchi,Koganam. Common name: false waterwillow.
Term: Anethum sowa Roxb. ex Flem.. Ayurveda name: athv. Unani name: Shibt/Soya. Siddha name: Sadha kuppai,Soyi keerai vidhai,Madhurikai, Sadhaputphi. Common name: Indian Dill, Sowa.
Term: Angelica glauca Edgew.. Ayurveda name: coraka. Unani name: Hasheeshat-al-Malik. Common name: angelica, wild celery.

Term: Aquilaria malaccensis Lam. Syn.. Ayurveda name: agaru. Unani name: Ood Hindi/ Agar/Ood Qimari/Ood Gharqi/Aghaloojan/ Aghalooji. Siddha name: Akil, Akaru, Poozhil, Kaakathundm, Aggalichandana. Common name: Aloewood, Eaglewood, Agarwood.
Term: Areca catechu Linn.. Ayurveda name: pga. Unani name: Fufal/Chalia/Chikni Supaari. Siddha name: Paakku,Kandhi adaikkai,Kamuku. Common name: betel palm.
Term: Argyeria nervosa. Ayurveda name: vddhadruka, basttr. Siddha name: Samuthirapachhai, Samuthira palai, Pey munnai, Ambagar, Sadar palai, Samuthira chogi. Common name: Elephant Creeper.
Term: Arundo donax Linn.. Ayurveda name: Nala. Unani name: Qasab. Siddha name: Korukkai. Common name: giant reed, giantreed.

Term: Asparagus racemosus Willd.. Ayurveda name: atvar, Med-Mahmed. Unani name: Satawar. Siddha name: Seemai sathaveri, Ammai kodi, Kadumulla, Mignthavanam, Varivari, Kilavari,Paniyanaku, Thanneervittankizhangu. Common name: Indian asparagus.
Term: Azadirachta indica A. Juss.. Ayurveda name: Nimba. Unani name: Neem. Siddha name: Vembu, Arittam, Nimbam, Paripathiram, Pisumantham, Vepachetta. Common name: neem.
Term: Bacopa monnieri. Ayurveda name: Brhm. Unani name: brahmi. Siddha name: Neerpirami, Sapthalai, Sarumam, Sambiranipoondu. Common name: coastal waterhyssop ,    herb of grace,    herb-of-grace.
Term: Balanites aegyptiaca. Ayurveda name: Ingud. Unani name: Ingad/Hingot/Allabakh. Siddha name: Nanjundaan. Common name: desert date.
Term: Baliospermum montanum. Ayurveda name: Dant. Unani name: Danti. Siddha name: Kattamanakku,Niradimuthu, Peyamanakku.

Term: Bambusa arundinacea. Ayurveda name: Vaa, Vaalocana, Basalocana. Unani name: Khumairah Bairah/Qirtas sokhtah/Tabasheer/Baans/Nae. Siddha name: Mungil, Mullumungil, Kazhai, Vaezhai, Thulai, Mulai. Common name: bamboo.
Term: Barleria cristata Linn.. Ayurveda name: Sahacara. Siddha name: Nilachemulli, Udamulli, Vellai neelamlbaram. Common name: crested Philippine violet.
Term: Barleria prionitis Linn.. Ayurveda name: Saireyaka. Unani name: Pya bansa/Jhinti. Siddha name: Semmulli. Common name: porcupine flower.
Term: Barleria strigosa Willd.. Ayurveda name: Sahacara. Siddha name: Nilambaram, Nili.
Term: Barringtonia acutangula. Ayurveda name: Nicula, samudra phala. Unani name: Samandarphal. Siddha name: Adambu, Kadappai, Sengadambu. Common name: Indian Oak.
Term: Basella alba Linn.. Ayurveda name: Upodik. Unani name: Poi/Bachla. Siddha name: Pasalikkeerai,Kodipasalikkeerai. Common name: Ceylon spinach.

Term: Bauhinia variegata Linn.. Ayurveda name: Kcanra. Unani name: Kachnal/Kachnar. Siddha name: Segapu manchori, Chemmandarai, Vellai puvathi. Common name: butterfly tree , mountain ebony,orchid tree, purple orchid tree.
Term: Benincasa hispida. Ayurveda name: kma. Unani name: Petha / Mahdayah/Kohila. Siddha name: Boosani, Kalyana poosani, Poosanikkai. Common name: waxgourd.
Term: Berberis aristata DC. / Berberis asiatica Roxb. / Berberis lycium Royle. Ayurveda name: druharidr. Siddha name: Maramanjal, Mullu kalaa, Usi kalaa. Common name: Indian Barberry.
Term: Bergenia ciliata. Ayurveda name: pa bheda. Unani name: Pakhan Bed/Kaasar-al-Shajr/Paashaan Bhed. Common name: aerva ,sessile joyweed.

Term: Bombax ceiba Linn.. Ayurveda name: lmali. Unani name: Saimul/Sembhal/Mocharas/Salmali. Siddha name: Mullilavu, Pulai,Poorani,Pongar,Mosam. Common name: red silk cottontree, Silk Cotton Tree, Red Cotton Tree.

Term: Carum carvi Linn.. Ayurveda name: kajraka. Unani name: Karoya / Qirdmana / Qirtmann / Kamoon Kirmaani/ Zeerah Siyaah. Siddha name: Seemai sombu, kekku vidhai,Seemai sombu. Common name: caraway , cumin caraway.

Term: Cassia fistula Linn.. Ayurveda name: ragvadha. Unani name: Amaltaas/Kheyaar shanbar. Siddha name: Kondrai, Aragoram, Idhali, Mathalai,Kiruthaamalam,Aakkuvadham, Konnei, Sarakonrai, Sarakonraipuli. Common name: golden shower.
Term: Cassia occidentalis Linn.. Ayurveda name: ksamarda. Unani name: Kasondi. Siddha name: Nattam takarai, Ponavirai, Peyavirai. Common name: coffee senna,septicweed.

Term: Cedrela toona Roxb.. Ayurveda name: tu, nandvka. Unani name: Tun. Siddha name: Sandhana vembu, Tunumaram. Common name: Red Cedar, Toon, Indian
Mahogany tree.
Term: Cedrus deodara. Ayurveda name: devadru. Unani name: Deodar. Siddha name: Devataaru,Iru thaaru,Thoon,Pathira tharugam,Thevatha surar maram, Tevadari. Common name: pinus deodara, himalayan cedar.
Term: Celastrus paniculatus Willd.. Ayurveda name: jyotimat. Unani name: Malkangni/Nammilnaraa. Siddha name: Athi parichan, Vaaluluvai, Kangkuni. Common name: staff tree.

Term: Chenopodium album Linn.. Ayurveda name: vstka, cill. Unani name: Bathwa/Qataf/ Sarmaq. Siddha name: Kattasambadam, Parupukkeerai. Common name: common lambsquarters, lambsquarters, lambsquarters goosefoot, white goosefoot.
Term: Chlorophytum tuberosum Baker / Asparagus adscendens Roxb.. Ayurveda name: mual veta.

Term: Cinnamomum camphora. Ayurveda name: karpra. Unani name: Kafoor. Siddha name: Karpooram, Kanagasaram, Kuruvikodi, Palidam, Sasi,. Sandiran, Soman, Soodan, Indu. Common name: camphor laurel, camphor tree, camphortree, Camphor.
Term: Cinnamomum cassia. Ayurveda name: tvak. Unani name: Qirfah. Siddha name: Lavangapattai. Common name: cassia.

Term: Cinnamomum tamala Nees. Ayurveda name: tejapatra, nalik. Unani name: Sazaj Hindi/ Patraj. Siddha name: Lavangapathri,Kattu karuvapattai, Kattu kirambu, Perialavangapattai, Thalisapatri. Common name: indian bark.
Term: Cinnamomum zeylanicum Blume. Ayurveda name: tvak. Unani name: Daarchini. Siddha name: Ilavangapattai,Karuvappattai. Common name: cinnamon.
Term: Cissampelos pareira Linn.. Ayurveda name: ph. Unani name: Paatha/Fareed Booti. Siddha name: Appatta, Puniaittitta, Sina, Titta, Tuvan, Vattattiruppi. Common name: pareira brava.
Term: Cissus quadrangularis Linn.. Ayurveda name: asthisahta, asthikhal. Siddha name: Pirandai, Vajravalli, Indiravalli, Utthanasanjeevi,Uchiradam. Common name: Square Stalked Vine, Adamant Creeper.
Term: Citrullus colocynthis. Ayurveda name: indravru. Unani name: Hanzal. Siddha name: Pei kummatti,Kalingam,Pichi kaay,Vari thummatti. Common name: colocynth.
Term: Citrus limon. Ayurveda name: jambra phala, nimbu. Unani name: Utraj/Lemoon. Siddha name: Periya elumichai. Common name: lemon.

Term: Citrus medica Linn.. Ayurveda name: bjapra. Unani name: Beej Purah/Bajoorah/Turanj/ Naaranj. Siddha name: Elumichai, Kadaranarathai, Kogilacham, Maruchagam,Pazham, Kommatti madulai, Narattampazham. Common name: citron.
Term: Cleome gynandra Linn.. Ayurveda name: ajagandh, tilapar?. Siddha name: Thai velai, Nalvelai, Kadugu. Common name: spider whisp, spiderflower, spiderwisp.

Term: Clerodendrum divaricatum Jack Syn.. Ayurveda name: bhrag. Unani name: Baharangi/Bharangi. Siddha name: Ankaravalli, Siruthekku, Kanduparangi, Vathamadakki. Common name: Turks Turban, Tube-flower.
Term: Clerodendrum indicum. Ayurveda name: bhrag. Unani name: Baharangi. Siddha name: Kavalai, Narivalai. Common name: turk's turbin.
Term: Clerodendrum multiflorum. Ayurveda name: agnimantha laghu, tarkr. Unani name: Taankal/Taankli/Arnie. Siddha name: Thaluthazhai, Vathamadakki.
Term: Clitoria ternatea Linn.. Ayurveda name: aparjit, akhapup. Unani name: Abrajita. Siddha name: Kakkarattan,Sangu pushbam,Kakkanam,Kakkanathi, Minni, Kumarimani. Common name: Asian pigeonwings.
Term: Coccinia grandis. Ayurveda name: bimb. Unani name: Kandoori/Bambi. Siddha name: Kovai, Kuwai. Common name: ivy gourd, scarlet-fruited gourd.

Term: Cocos nucifera Linn.. Ayurveda name: nrikela. Unani name: Narjeel/Naryal. Siddha name: Thenkaai, Naalikeram, Poologakarpaga vritcham, Mudiyarasan, Mukkannan,Ilaangali,Thennai. Common name: coconut palm.
Term: Coleus vettiveroides K.C. Jacob / Valeriana jatamansii Jones Syn.. Ayurveda name: hrbera, blaka. Siddha name: Guru ver,Vetriver,Vizhal ver,Viranam,Iruveli.
Term: Commiphora myrrha. Ayurveda name: bola. Unani name: Mur Makki / Beja Baul. Siddha name: Vellaippapolam, Valendrapolam, Kungkumatheepam, Meeru. Common name: Actiniopteris.
Term: Commiphora wightii Bhandari Syn.. Ayurveda name: guggulu. Unani name: Muqil. Siddha name: Maisaatchi kungilium, Gukkulu, Poonaikkan kungilium. Common name: Indian Bdellium, Gum Guggul.
Term: Convolvulus microphyllus Sieb. ex Spreng. Syn.. Ayurveda name: akhapup.
Term: Corallocarpus epigaeus Benth. ex Hook. f.. Ayurveda name: ukans, nahik. Siddha name: Aakaasa karudan,Kollankovai,Pei seendhil.
Term: Coriandrum sativum Linn.. Ayurveda name: dhnyaka. Unani name: Kishneez. Siddha name: Kottha malli,Urularisi,Dhaniya. Common name: Chinese parsley, Chinese-parsley, coriander.
Term: Crateva nurvala Buch. -Ham.. Ayurveda name: varua. Unani name: Barna.. Siddha name: Mavilingam, Kumaarakam, Varani, Maralingam.
Term: Crinum latifolium Linn.. Ayurveda name: sudarana. Unani name: Sukh Darshan. Siddha name: Vishamoongil. Common name: Wide-leaved Crinum.
Term: Crocus sativus Linn.. Ayurveda name: kukuma. Unani name: Zafran/Gumr/ Gumrah. Siddha name: Kungumapoo,Gnalal poo,Kashmiram. Common name: saffron crocus, Saffron.

Term: Croton tiglium Linn.. Ayurveda name: jayapla. Unani name: Habb-al- Mulook/Maahudaana. Siddha name: Nervaalam, Naganam, Saiyabalam,Nigumbam, Thendi, Chiduram, Shobi, Nagathenthi. Common name: purging croton.
Term: Cryptolepis buchanani. Ayurveda name: kasriv, jambpatr sriv.
Term: Cucumis melo Linn.. Ayurveda name: ervru. Unani name: Kakri/Kheyaarzah/Qissa. Siddha name: Vellarikkai, Kakkarikkai. Common name: Snake Cucumber.

Term: Cuminum cyminum Linn.. Ayurveda name: vetajraka. Unani name: Zeerah. Siddha name: Seerakam, Asai, Seeri, Posanakudori,Upakumba peesam,Pittha naasini,Prathivikaa,Methiyam. Common name: cumin, Cumin seed.
Term: Curculigo orchioides Gaertn.. Ayurveda name: tlaml, mual. Unani name: Musli Siyah. Siddha name: Nilappanankizhanku,Vaaraagi,Kurathi,Chithi,Thalai thathu,Nila velumi,Thaalamooli,Thirana rasan.
Term: Curcuma amada Roxb.. Ayurveda name: haridr mragandhi. Unani name: Aamba Haldi. Siddha name: Maankaai inji, Mamediallam, Arukamilaka. Common name: mango ginger.
Term: Curcuma zedoaria. Ayurveda name: a, karcra. Unani name: Tumiri/Kacchuri/ Kachuri/Zarambad. Siddha name: Kichili kizhangu, Pulan kizhangu,Kacholam,Kachoram. Common name: zedoary.
Term: Cymbopogon martini. Ayurveda name: rohiata. Unani name: Teen-e-Makkah. Siddha name: Kaavattampullu. Common name: rosha grass.

Term: Cynodon dactylon. Ayurveda name: drv. Unani name: Doob / Najm. Siddha name: Arukan pull, Patham, Moothandam, Dhurvaathi, Megari, Ganapathi pathiram. Common name: Bermudagrass, chiendent pied-de-poule, common bermudagrass, devilgrass, grama-seda, manienie, motie molulu.

Term: Cyperus rotundus Linn. / Cyperus scariosus R. Br. / Cyperus arundinaceum Baker. Ayurveda name: mustaka, gaadrv. Unani name: Nager motha/Saad Kufi / Sad Kufi. Siddha name: ,muthakasu ,varaga patchani,korai kizhangu. Common name: chaguan humatag, cocograss, kili'o'opu, nutgrass, pakopako, purple nutsedge.
Term: Datura metel Linn. / Datura inoxia Mill. / Datura stramonium Linn.. Ayurveda name: dhattra. Siddha name: Vel oomatthai, Ponoomathai. Common name: Thornapple, Downy Datura.
Term: Dendrophthoe falcata. Ayurveda name: bandka, sahar, vkdan. Siddha name: Ottunni,Pulluruvi, Ottu, Maravotti.
Term: Desmodium gangeticum. Ayurveda name: lapar. Unani name: Patraheen/Salparni. Siddha name: Pulladi.
Term: Desmostachya bipinnata. Ayurveda name: kua. Unani name: Daab. Siddha name: Tharuppai, Kumudham, Visuvaamiththiram, Kusaippul. Common name: Sacrificial Grass.
Term: Dichrostachys cinerea. Ayurveda name: vrataru. Siddha name: Vidatthalai. Common name: aroma.
Term: Diospyros discolor Willd.. Ayurveda name: tinduka. Common name: mabolo.
Term: Eclipta prostrata. Ayurveda name: bhgarja. Unani name: Bhangra. Siddha name: Kaiyanthakarai, Vellai karisalai. Common name: eclipta, false daisy.
Term: Elaeocarpus sphaericus. Ayurveda name: rudrka. Siddha name: Uruthiraatcham. Common name: Utrasum Bead tree.
Term: Elettaria cardamomum. Ayurveda name: skmail. Unani name: Heel Khurd/Qaaqulah Sagheer. Siddha name: Yaelakkai,Aanji,Dhudi,Korangam. Common name: cardamom, Lesser Cardamom.

Term: Embelia ribes Burm. f. / Embelia tsjeriam-cottam A. Dc Syn. E. robusta C.B Clarke. Ayurveda name: viaga. Unani name: Baobarang/Babrang/Bakaj Kabuli/Abranj/Barnaq. Siddha name: Vaayvidangam, Keralam, Varnanai, Vellal. Common name: Embelia..

Term: Erythrina variegata Linn.. Ayurveda name: pribhadra. Unani name: Mandara. Siddha name: Kalyana murungai, Parisatham, Mullu murungai, Muchi, Savuchayam, Vallai, Kinjugam. Common name: tiger's claw.
Term: Euphorbia dracunculoides Lam.. Ayurveda name: saptal. Siddha name: Tillakada.
Term: Euphorbia neriifolia Linn.. Ayurveda name: snuh. Unani name: Thuhar. Siddha name: Ilaikalli, Manchevi kalli, Naynakki, Nadangi. Common name: Indian spurgetree.

Term: Euphorbia thomsoniana Boiss. / Argemone mexicana Linn.. Ayurveda name: svarakr. Siddha name: Kudiyotti, Biramathandu, Brahmmathandu, Kurukkumchedi. Common name: Argemone mexicana-Prickly Poppy, Mexican Poppy.
Term: Euphorbia thymifolia Linn.. Ayurveda name: dugdhik. Siddha name: Chithirapaalaadai, Chiru ammaan pacharisi.
Term: Fagonia cretica Linn. / Alhagi pseudalhagi. Ayurveda name: dhanvaysa. Unani name: Dhamaya/Dhamasa/Shukaai'. Siddha name: Ootagamul or Korandimul.. Common name: Camel Thorn, Persian Manna Plant.
Term: Feronia limonia. Ayurveda name: kapittha. Unani name: Hab habu. Siddha name: Ootagamul or Korandimul, Narivila, Kuttivila, Nilavila, Vilanga. Common name: Wood Apple.

Term: Ferula foetida regel. Ayurveda name: higu. Unani name: Hilteet/Heeng/Anjodaan. Siddha name: Perungayam;Gayam,Pothanasam,Ingu,Santhunasam,Athiyakirakaram,Valeegam, Sagasthirabedhi. Common name: asafetida.

Term: Ficus benghalensis Linn.. Ayurveda name: nyagrodha, vaa. Siddha name: Aalamaram, Vadam, Pootham, Vanongi, Iyakkurotham, Pudavritcham, Vadavirukam, Palu maram, thol m. Common name: Indian banyan.
Term: Ficus carica Linn.. Ayurveda name: phalgu, bhadrodumbara. Unani name: Injeer/Teen. Siddha name: Seemaiatthi, Thaen atthi. Common name: common fig, edible fig, fiku, piku.
Term: Ficus hispid Linn.f.. Ayurveda name: kkodumbara, phalgu malay. Unani name: Teen-e-Banghali. Siddha name: Paeyatti, Sonatti, Kattatti, Ottannalam,Malaiatti,Asamandham.
Term: Ficus racemosa Linn.. Ayurveda name: udumbara. Unani name: Gular/ Jummaiz/Alaf Hindi. Siddha name: Atthi, Atham, Athavu, Uthumbaram, Koli, Supirathashtam. Common name: clustertree.

Term: Ficus religiosa Linn.. Ayurveda name: avattha. Unani name: Peepal. Siddha name: Arasu, Aswatham, Bodi, Kanavam, Pippilam, Megathurumam, Narayanam, , Vanagandhi, Thiru maram. Common name: peepul tree.
Term: Ficus virens Ait.. Ayurveda name: plaka. Siddha name: Kurugu. Common name: White Fig.

Term: Foeniculum vulgare Mill.. Ayurveda name: madhurik, mirey. Unani name: Baadiyaan/Saunf/Baadiyaan Barri/Shivmaar/Shoomar/ Raazeyaana. Siddha name: Shombu, Perungeeram, Sohikeerai. Common name: sweet fennel, Fennel.
Term: Fritillaria roylei Hook. / Withania somnifera. Ayurveda name: krakkol? kukku.

Term: Fumaria indica Pugsley Syn.. Ayurveda name: parpaa bheda. Unani name: Shaahtara / Shaahtraj. Siddha name: Tharaa,Tusa, Tura,Pamba tharaa,Madhugam. Common name: fine-leaf fumitory, fineleaf fumitory, Small Flowered Fumitory.
Term: Fumaria vaillantii Loisel.. Ayurveda name: parpaa. Siddha name: Thura. Common name: earthsmoke.
Term: Garcinia cambogia Desr.. Ayurveda name: vkmla bheda. Siddha name: Kodukkapuli, Aradal. Common name: Gamboge tree.
Term: Garcinia indica Chois.. Ayurveda name: vkmla. Siddha name: Murgal. Common name: garcinia.

Term: Garcinia morella. Ayurveda name: kakuha, tamla. Unani name: Seyaam Taal/Tamaal/Kaala Taad/Farfiraan-e-Hindi. Siddha name: Makki  ,Solai puli, Iravel sinni, Korag puli. Common name: Indian Gamboge.
Term: Garcinia pedunculata Roxb.. Ayurveda name: amlavetasa.

Term: Gentiana kurroo Royle. Ayurveda name: tryama, tryant. Unani name: Neel Kanthi/Pashanbheda/Utparbahi. Siddha name: Nilavembu. Common name: Himalayan Gentian, Indian
Gentian Root.
Term: Gloriosa superba Linn.. Ayurveda name: lgal. Siddha name: Kalappaikizhangu,Karthikai kizhangu,Kandhal kizhangu,Ven thondri kizhangu,Ilangali kizhangu. Common name: flame lily.
